---
title: "GDM2 distance matrix (Walesiak) for ordinal service ratings"
output: html_document
---

This R step computes the GDM2 distance matrix with `clusterSim::dist.GDM` and
exports it so the Python notebook can use it for K-Medoids clustering.

Run order: (1) run notebook 01 up to the cell that writes
`ordinal_features_for_gdm2.csv`, (2) knit this file, (3) go back to the notebook.

```{r setup}
if (!requireNamespace("clusterSim", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("clusterSim")
library(clusterSim)
```

```{r load}
# Ordinal-encoded features (0 = Unacceptable ... 4 = Excellent), exported by the notebook.
# Place the file in the same folder as this .Rmd (it is not included in the repo).
x <- read.csv("ordinal_features_for_gdm2.csv")
head(x)
```

```{r gdm2}
gdm2 <- dist.GDM(x, method = "GDM2")
gdm2_matrix <- as.matrix(gdm2)
dim(gdm2_matrix)
gdm2_matrix[1:5, 1:5]
```

```{r export}
write.csv(gdm2_matrix, "gdm2_distance_matrix.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
